agent_notes: «חגרות»: «опоясания» (так в Синодальном) в буквальном слое, «набедренные повязки» в драматическом; в комментарии объяснено, что Синодальный здесь совпадает с буквальным значением «пояса».
«קול» передано как «звук» в буквальном слое (причастие «ходящий» относится к звуку или к Богу), Синодальный — «голос».
Синодальный добавляет в скобках «[Адам,]»; в еврейском тексте этого нет, поэтому в переводе «человек» с артиклем (ха-адам), как и в английском комментарии.

notes.note: Chapter-wide: the text gives no time word between Gen 2:25 and 3:1, so the whole chapter hangs on evt.gen_2.man_speaks_one_flesh with a one-year margin on the first scene (MACRO_ERA). The only hour in the chapter is 'the wind of the day' (3:8), set at late afternoon (BEIN_HAARBAYIM) after Rashi (the west wind toward evening) and Radak (evening). Rashi, citing Sanhedrin 38b, says the sin fell on the tenth hour of the sixth day, i.e. the same day as the creation of man; I do not force that, and leave the day open (12-hour margin on 3:8), but the dry-run dates will show whether the chain lands on day 6.

Words that come true: God's warning at 2:17 ('in the day you eat of it you shall surely die') is not fulfilled in this chapter in any narrated death (the expulsion at 3:23-24 is often read as the 'death', but the text does not say so); the death of Adam is told in Gen 5:5, and the return to dust (3:19) is fulfilled there too, so the Gen 5 session should write FULFILLS_PROPHECY. The enmity of 3:15 and the pain of childbirth (3:16) point to Gen 4 (Cain and Abel; births), whose session should consider those links. The thorns and sweat of 3:17-19 are fulfilled by the toil of Gen 3:23 only in the sense of sending out to till; no link written.
All verses 3:1-24 are covered. The serpent's speech (3:4-5) is not treated as prophecy (it is a claim, contradicted in 3:7-11 only in part).

[event:evt.gen_3.serpent_tempts_woman] Anchored on the last Gen 2 scene of the man and woman (2:23-25, 'naked and not ashamed') rather than on the Sabbath summary (2:1-3), which is a retrospective frame for the week. The gap between 2:25 and 3:1 is unstated; the margin of a year is a deliberately wide placeholder, not a claim.

[event:evt.gen_3.curse_serpent] 3:14-19 are three sentences (serpent, woman, man) given in sequence in one judgment scene; I split them because each has its own addressee and effect, and ordered them as the text does. Pseudo-Jonathan 3:14 says God brought all three to judgment together, consistent with one continuous scene.

[event:evt.gen_3.eve_named] 3:20 is undated relative to the judgment (the naming is a narrative aside after the curses and before the garments). Placed after the curse on the man with a one-day margin; it could equally follow the clothing (3:21). Order in the verses is kept.

[event:evt.gen_3.god_clothes_them] Considered a link from the eyes-opened scene (nakedness) to the clothing as ENABLES or TRIGGERS; dropped because the text states no 'because' and God's act is not said to respond to their shame.

[entity:person.woman_of_eden] The registry proposes person.eve (Eve@Gen.3.20-1Ti), but the corpus already holds the same woman as person.woman_of_eden (GEN.2). To avoid a duplicate I did not create person.eve; the woman keeps her id and gains a name state (comp.woman_of_eden.name.1). Her entity text is locked (approved), so the alias Eve and the etymology (Chavvah, 'living', 3:20) could not be added there; a reviewer may want to request that. The TIPNR Eve id is therefore not linked to any entity; the reviewer may prefer to relink or merge.

[entity:loc.garden_of_eden] TIPNR tags 'Eden' in 3:23-24 with person.eran (a Numbers 26 clan head); this is a registry error and was ignored. Garden of Eden / loc.garden_of_eden is the place. No coordinates in the corpus for the garden.
[component:comp.adam.life.1] Left open (LIVING): 3:19 announces return to dust but no death occurs in this chapter; Adam's death is not recorded here.

[entity:person.serpent] The serpent is an animal 'of the field' (3:1) that speaks; the schema has no animal type. I made it a PERSON-type character rather than a SPIRIT_BEING, since the text does not call it a spirit (later identification with Satan is outside Genesis 3). No tipnr_id.
[entity:group.cherubim] Cherubim (3:24) modelled as a GROUP of unnamed heavenly guardians, not SPIRIT_BEING individuals, because the text gives only the plural.
[entity:loc.ground] The cursed ground (ha-adamah, 3:17) is modelled as a LOCATION so it can carry the state CURSED. It has no coordinates; none invented.

[entity:loc.garden_of_eden] TIPNR tags 'Eden' in 3:23-24 with person.eran (a Numbers 26 clan head); this is a registry error and was ignored. Garden of Eden / loc.garden_of_eden is the place. No coordinates in the corpus for the garden.

[event_links:evt.gen_3.serpent_tempts_woman] Place carried over from GEN.2: the garden of Eden. The man is not named as present in 3:1-5, though 'with her' in 3:6 implies he is; I list him only in the fruit event.

[component:comp.adam.shame.2] Inferred: 3:7 says they knew they were naked and covered themselves, 3:10 says Adam was afraid because naked. Value AWARE_OF_NAKEDNESS rather than 'ashamed', which the text does not use.
[component:comp.adam.mood.1] Fear is read from 3:10; left open because the text does not say when it ends.
[component:comp.tree_of_life.access.1] Read from 3:22-24: access is barred by cherubim and the sword. The tree of knowledge stays FORBIDDEN (comp.tree_of_knowledge.access.1 not closed).

[system:sys.divine_curse] New system defined for the curses on the serpent (3:14) and the ground (3:17); the man and woman themselves are not cursed in the text.
[instance:inst.gen_3.judgment_on_woman] Modelled with the existing sys.divine_decree, as the pain in childbearing and the husband's rule are pronounced, not 'cursed'.
